brief:
Britain is threatening to escalate its response to Israeli settlements, the Ma'an news agency reported. The statement marks a potential shift in London's approach to the occupation, signaling willingness to pursue more stringent measures against settlement expansion.

Details of the threatened action remain unclear, though Britain has previously considered various forms of sanctions and boycotts targeting the settlement enterprise. The threat comes amid ongoing international criticism of settlement policies in occupied Palestinian territory.
title: Britain threatens stronger sanctions on Israeli settlements
